title: Check how long the system has been running
summary: Use the uptime command to see how long your computer has been on, how many users are logged in, and the current load. It helps you know if the system was recently restarted or if it has been running for a long time.

aliases.text: how long has my computer been on

steps.explain: Run the uptime command to display the current time, how long the system has been running, the number of logged-in users, and system load averages.
steps.expect: Output showing current time, uptime duration, number of users, and load averages.
